files.content: Pixel FAQ

# Pixel FAQ

A single-page FAQ application with a pixel-art aesthetic. Click a question to expand its answer and collapse any other open one. Arrow indicators show open state. Expand all / Collapse all buttons are provided.

## Features

- 5 FAQ items with toggleable answers
- Accordion behavior: only one answer open at a time
- Arrow rotates to indicate open state
- Expand all / Collapse all buttons
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive design from 360px wide
- No external dependencies, packages, or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main HTML structure
- `styles.css` – all styling
- `script.js` – interaction logic

## Accessibility

- Questions are `<button>` elements with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`
- Answers have `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby`
- Focus outlines are visible
- Controls are labeled
